title: Crowding affects structural dynamics and contributes to membrane association of the NS3/4A complex.
authors: Ostrowska, Natalia; Feig, Michael; Trylska, Joanna
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究拥挤环境对HCV NS3/4A复合物中无序NS4A尾部的结构动态及膜结合的影响，聚焦无序片段构象变化与功能关联，但互作对象为病毒蛋白酶复合物而非典型PPI，机制建模深度中等。
abstract: Using molecular dynamics simulations, we describe how crowded environments affect the internal dynamics and diffusion of the hepatitis C virus proteases NS3/4A. This protease plays a key role in viral replication and is successfully used as a target for antiviral treatment. The NS3 enzyme requires a peptide cofactor, called NS4A, with its central part interacting with the NS3 beta-sheet, and flexible, protruding terminal tails that are unstructured in water solution. The simulations describe the enzyme and water molecules at atomistic resolution, whereas crowders are modeled via either all-atom or coarse-grained models to emphasize different aspects of crowding. Crowders reflect the polyethylene glycol (PEG) molecules used in the experiments to mimic the crowded surrounding. A bead-shell model of folded coarse-grained PEG molecules considers mainly the excluded volume effect, whereas all-atom PEG models afford more protein-like crowder interactions. Circular dichroism spectroscopy experiments of the NS4A N-terminal tail show that a helical structure is formed in the presence of PEG crowders. The simulations suggest that crowding may assist in the formation of an NS4A helical fragment, positioned exactly where a transmembrane helix would fold upon the NS4A contact with the membrane. In addition, partially interactive PEGs help the NS4A N-tail to detach from the protease surface, thus enabling the process of helix insertion and potentially helping the virus establish a replication machinery needed to produce new viruses. Results point to an active role of crowding in assisting structural changes in disordered protein fragments that are necessary for their biological function.
abstract_zh: 利用分子动力学模拟，我们描述了拥挤环境如何影响丙型肝炎病毒蛋白酶NS3/4A的内部动力学和扩散。该蛋白酶在病毒复制中扮演关键角色，并成功用作抗病毒治疗的靶点。NS3酶需要一种称为NS4A的肽辅因子，其中心部分与NS3的β-折叠相互作用，而柔性的、突出的末端尾巴在水溶液中呈无序状态。模拟以原子级分辨率描述了酶和水分子，而拥挤剂则通过全原子或粗粒化模型进行建模，以强调拥挤的不同方面。拥挤剂反映了实验中用于模拟拥挤周围环境的聚乙二醇（PEG）分子。折叠的粗粒化PEG分子的珠壳模型主要考虑排除体积效应，而全原子PEG模型则提供更类似蛋白质的拥挤剂相互作用。NS4A N端尾巴的圆二色光谱实验表明，在PEG拥挤剂存在下会形成螺旋结构。模拟提示，拥挤可能有助于NS4A螺旋片段的形成，该片段恰好位于NS4A与膜接触时跨膜螺旋折叠的位置。此外，部分相互作用的PEG有助于NS4A N端尾巴从蛋白酶表面脱离，从而促进螺旋插入过程，并可能帮助病毒建立产生新病毒所需的复制机制。结果表明，拥挤在无序蛋白质片段的结构变化中发挥积极作用，这些变化对其生物学功能至关重要。
